zero_base_control.scope: Zero adapter compared to original base at last-prefill+15decode scores per cold/hot case; no real-adapter D/B shared-prefix or task-quality metric.

mixed_policy.scope: Complete R84 forward/reverse mixed policies on GPU2/R55 at equal KV65536/SSM256/mem.52. Six measured batches per policy/cache; pooled rates and request latency distributions reconstructed from native original SSE. Concurrent queues, nominal cache labels and small repeat count must be considered. No confidence interval, measured bandwidth, isolated-machine, larger topology, real prefix-hit or overall goal acceptance. The full R105 recheck retains all R84 precision/lifecycle/prefix gates and first-three kernel profiles; no new profile inferred for reverse controls.

million_context.scope: TP1 BF16 eager deterministic; identical fixed 999744-token prompt and 256 natural output tokens. D/M/base ran on separate GPUs while other experiments ran concurrently. A single round is partial evidence; full 18-request matrix requires three rounds. Native ID agreement and runtime completion are not full-prompt logprob or long-context task quality acceptance.

limitations: R28/R34/R55 are distinct runtimes; only compute paired within-cohort ratios.
Cold/hot refers to prefix-KV flush; projection caches are prewarmed, first fill and registration are separate.
Separate-time controls and background work prevent isolated universal speed claims.
TP1 fixedKV65536 can queue at c32*2304=73728 tokens.
Natural output agreement and logprob alignment do not establish task accuracy or long-context quality.
Original base has different weights; real-adapter D/B shared-prefix logprob difference and held-out quality are not measured.
